title: South Korea draft bill puts stablecoins, RWAs under finance laws: Report
summary: The draft proposal from South Korea’s ruling party reportedly bars stablecoin interest and calls for technical standards to ensure interoperability across blockchain networks.

title: Thailand proposes tighter scrutiny of funders behind crypto firms
summary: Thailand’s SEC proposes tightening funding rules for cryptocurrency companies to include anyone backing major shareholders, directly or indirectly.

title: NYT revives Adam Back theory in latest bid to identify Bitcoin creator
summary: A New York Times investigation points to Adam Back as Satoshi Nakamoto, but the Blockstream CEO denies it, and critics say proof is still missing.

title: Oil falls, Bitcoin jumps to $72K, but is this BTC price breakout for real?
summary: Bitcoin rose toward $72,000 after US President Donald Trump confirmed a ceasefire agreement with Iran, sending oil prices crashing below $100.

title: ARK buys $13M in Robinhood as US Treasury taps platform for Trump Accounts
summary: Cathie Wood's ARK Invest increased its Robinhood stake after the platform was selected to operate government-backed “Trump Accounts” for youth savings and investment.

title: UBS partners with five banks for Swiss franc stablecoin sandbox
summary: UBS, PostFinance, Sygnum and others launched a 2026 sandbox to test Swiss franc stablecoin use cases and blockchain payment rails in Switzerland.

title: Will quantum-safe cryptography slow Ethereum down? The performance tradeoff explained
summary: Will quantum-safe cryptography slow Ethereum? It is likely to affect gas fees, validator load and network efficiency, prompting Ethereum to pursue a broader redesign strategy.

title: Ethereum stablecoin supply hits $180B all-time high: Token Terminal
summary: Ethereum could see $850 billion in “new flows” by 2030 if the trend continues, according to Token Terminal.

title: Three Polymarket traders made timely bets on US-Iran ceasefire
summary: Lookonchain noted that the “yes” bets were placed at probabilities between 2.9% and 10.3%, with the three wallets placing their first bets within 26 hours of the announcement.

title: Coinbase plans expansion to stock trading in Australia after securing license
summary: The approval puts Coinbase under Australia’s financial rules as the country formalizes oversight of crypto platforms.
